name: Isomerisation (C5/C6)
principle: Light straight-run naphtha (pentanes and hexanes) is converted over a catalyst, typically chlorinated alumina, into branched isomers with higher octane. Equilibrium limits a once-through unit, so recycle schemes separate unconverted normal paraffins with a deisohexaniser or molecular sieves and send them back.

performance.basis: Axens, for 40:60 C5:C6 feed starting at RON about 70

source.note: Axens C5/C6 isomerization page, read 24 October 2026

performance.metric: isomerate RON, recycle with molecular sieves (Hexorb)
performance.basis: Axens, at C5/C6 ratio 0.65; deisohexaniser recycle gives about 88

source.note: Axens C5/C6 isomerization page, read 24 October 2026

advantages: Cheap octane from low-value light naphtha
No aromatics or olefins in product
limitations: Chlorided catalysts need very dry, sulfur-free feed
